==Relics & Notes==
'''My relics (You don't have to choose these to follow this guide):''' 
* [[Endless Harvest (Demonic Pacts League)|Endless Harvest]]
* [[Woodsman (Demonic Pacts League)|Woodsman]]
* [[Evil Eye (Demonic Pacts League)|Evil Eye]]
* [[Butler's Bell (Demonic Pacts League)|Butler's Bell]]
* [[Larcenist (Demonic Pacts League)|Larcenist]]
* [[Culling Spree (Demonic Pacts League)|Culling Spree]]
* [[Soul Harvest (Demonic Pacts League)|Reload: Soul Harvest]]
* [[Minion (Demonic Pacts League)|Minion]]

'''Notes on the route:'''
* The guide leans in favor of my relics, so if you're taking different tier 1s and 2s, just consider you might need to adjust slightly at some points. 
* The amount of items to buy is intentional, particularly early. {{Colour|Red|Don't buy more than mentioned because the amount of coins you have in your inventory matters.}}
